scripts.dev: bun run generate:version && bun run ensure:agent-placeholder && bun run src/index.ts
scripts.build: bun run generate:version && bun run typecheck && bun run scripts/build.ts
scripts.install:local: bun run build && mkdir -p ~/.lazy/bin && mv lazy ~/.lazy/bin/lazy && mv lazy-agent ~/.lazy/bin/lazy-agent && echo 'Installation to ~/.lazy.bin complete.'
scripts.generate:version: test -f scripts/generate-version.ts && bun run scripts/generate-version.ts || true
scripts.test: bun run generate:version && bun run ensure:agent-placeholder && bun test --timeout 30000
scripts.test:e2e: bun run generate:version && bun run ensure:agent-placeholder && bun test --timeout 30000 test/e2e/
scripts.test:all: bun run generate:version && bun run ensure:agent-placeholder && LAZY_SLOW_TESTS=1 bun test --timeout 30000
scripts.prepare: bun run generate:version && bun run ensure:agent-placeholder
